ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job and the mid-fight clock is fun to watch, but the Brood build's own board barely grows: its power sits in an unseen Brood number and Chicks that vanish after the fight.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because it is the only tribe that acts on the enemy board and feeds on the enemy's size: Eggs on enemy units hatch into Chicks sized off their hosts, on a shared mid-fight clock.

verdict_why: The shape is good; two small rules gaps (Wind against the Tower's faster Hour, and a hidden Gernegroß when everything else dies) are worth one more pass.

points.text: Wind says the Hour strikes at once at 4 or more, but under Hour-Keeper of the Tower the Hour comes every 2. Say "at the Hour's count or more" so Key-Turner plus the Tower reads.
While Little Gernegroß is hidden he isn't a unit. If all your other units die first, say whether you lose at once or he still hatches and fights.
In the Brood build the board itself stays at printed stats from Tier 1 to 6. Let Brood also show on the Layers (say a quarter of it), so you watch the board grow, not just a counter.
Nest-Box Dormouse is the only way Chicks turn into permanent stats. A Tier 5 or 6 version (eat two, or eat any Chick that lands) would give the late game a growth spine.

standouts.why: Little Gernegroß hides on the biggest enemy and comes back huge: a great moment, and with Mother Rohrsang a real payoff.
Nest-Box Dormouse makes you leave a hole on purpose and eat your own Chick: a fresh placement call that grows with the enemy.
Pipit-Moor Placer turns scouting the back row into a decision and keeps Eggs safe until the Hour.

weakest.why: First-Call Herald is plain gold with a light clock hook; it adds nothing to the tribe's choices.
Key-Turner does nothing alone and costs a slot the Chicks need; it only earns its place in pairs.
Jar Dormouse sleeping a 1/3 early mostly makes you attack second; Wind 4 makes its sleep moot.

flags.note: Golden Mother Rohrsang makes Chicks full copies of their hosts; with Kasimir or Gernegroß that is the whole enemy board copied, limited only by room.
Golden Hour-Keeper with Door Cuckoo lays an Egg every attack, and Chicks shove even with no room, so high Brood turns into uncapped free damage.
Ottilie doubles other tribes' Start of Combat cards; the strongest of them at x2 or x3 need a check.
Frau Wechselbalg is a free Discover most turns at Tier 4; hot economy worth the owner's eye.
Wind's threshold of 4 doesn't say how it works when the Tower makes the Hour every 2 attacks.
Not stated what happens if Gernegroß is hidden and every other unit of yours dies.
